1.label: very_easy
1.natural_language: Each plate has two moving guides, marked with a dot or diamond; one is a reflected ghost. Sweep the loupe over each covered plate sleeve to find its true registration stamp. Discovered stamps stay visible. Inspect and prepare before START PRESS; inspection never pauses a running press. Keep each solid handle's cross inside the guide matching that plate's stamp. The short trail shows recent drift; the dotted line and small bead show the next 600 ms. The square is your commanded position: the solid handle follows with inertia. Clean exposure accumulates only while all crosses are inside their rings; paper keeps feeding otherwise. Color separation outside a ring permanently spoils the paper. Finish 24 seconds of clean exposure within 40 seconds, before the spoil gauge fills. There is one attempt; an early submission ends it.
1.summary: 1 independent plates, 1 axes, 23 px tolerance, 180 ms actuator response.

full.summary: Sweep a loupe over plate sleeves to identify their registration marks, then drag each physical color handle on its pad.

simplified.summary: Use the same sleeve loupe and registration marks, then click a pad to command the same actuator position; no snapping.
